decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher sits close to the firm's core postpress know-how, so the firm can interpret its early results and refine it, which favours keeping it.

UV spot varnishing lies farther from the firm's core, but the product is distributed from an established partner (Duplo) and received a visible German premiere, so the firm likely keeps it in the portfolio despite weaker related knowledge.
The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's established modular systems, which allows it to assimilate feedback and integrate the module into its workflows.
The B2 multifinisher is close to the core offer and was prominently launched on the home page, fitting the firm's direction toward automated finishing.
The hybrid saddle stitcher extends the firm's booklet-making expertise, where its existing application know-how supports learning from early results.
The folding add-on is close to the core offer and already shows a documented customer installation, which confirms that it can be applied commercially.
